cellToUV: cell k: column = k % 16, row = floor(k / 16) counted from the TOP of the image. With three.js flipY: u0 = column/16, v0 = 1 - (row + 1)/16, size 1/16.
quad: corners p +- v1 +- v2 (v1, v2 are half-edge vectors, light years); each card has a random fixed orientation. Dome look: additive blending (black margins vanish).
groups: A = earlier galaxies (s < 0.80), B = later; on the dome A fades in 3 s into step 5 and B at 8 s.
